additional_finding.reason: SIGALRM handler can run after wait4 has reaped but before reaped flag is set. Exception cleanup may signal a PID no longer owned/unreaped. Successful child CPU receipt can also be lost in that window.
additional_finding.resolution: poll_own blocks SIGALRM only during nonblocking wait4 and full PID/status/usage/returncode/reaped bookkeeping. Finally restores mask; pending timeout then sees reaped=true and skips kill. Sleep outside mask. Cleanup uses default hard15s alarm so cannot re-enter normal timeout handler; unavoidable cleanup hardkill may lose receipt and is explicitly excluded from certified completion.

Apply equivalent safe bookkeeping to cleanup; never wait blocking with deadline masked indefinitely.

prior_finding.reason: Outer alarm begins before launching child; both alarms have same 75s duration. A stalled child can outlive the earlier outer SIGALRM. Default outer termination interrupts wait4 without a finally that kills/reaps its own child and persists a receipt. prior_finding.required_resolution: Handle outer timeout with own-unreaped-child cleanup and wait4/receipt persistence, and give parent cleanup headroom relative to child wall alarm.
